scope: One fixed dense-solver point; evaluate original source family,not choose a point. A-probe protocol is fixed before any actual quantized source-point score is inspected.
B_probes: Existing640 frozen B-task probes,original source RMS and contexts.

A_probes.contexts: First original teacher occurrence per class in source cache; require all within first128 otherwise stop,do not replace contexts.
A_probes.RMS_inputs: Original first128 source contexts,captured in the same128 batch as cached scores.
A_probes.construction: Top32 right singular vectors of Ae-A0; finite changes x±.01 RMS*V_A. QuickGELU evaluated at perturbed inputs; preserve fixed baseline FP32 activation rounding as an additive offset. Full final LN and feature normalization,all competing margins.

confirmation.exclusions: All original source-split excluded metadata and4096 construction indices plus every registered confirmation and explicit budget witness.

stop_rule: Freeze the sole quantized B weight hash before any point source score. Any actual D>0.5,source/probe R>0.5,changed native prediction or fixed numerical tolerance failure closes the point. No solver-point selection,scaling,rank/axis/data/seed change. Source feasibility is not confirmation/full-task/TA/AGA proof. No partner/test/confirmation input until eligible.
